texts.content:
Like most lifeforms in Maxkodia, this rabid creature carries lethal toxicity,
its spines concentrate neurotoxins capable of inducing paralysis within seconds.
It is a small, nocturnal predator, fiercely solitary.

It does not form groups or share territory; its aggression and metabolic demands make
proximity intolerable. Even so, it is preyed upon by larger hunters that have developed partial
immunity to its toxins. These predators execute precise maneuvers to tear it apart,
exploiting the vulnerability of its bloated, fleshy body.

Sightings are rare. It emerges only during its brief reproductive phase,
when it leaves the deep fissures and exposes itself to the environment
driven by a biological urgency that overrides its instinct to remain hidden.
